scripts.api:check: pnpm api:generate && git diff --exit-code -- packages/api-client/openapi.json packages/api-client/src/schema.d.ts
scripts.api:generate: tsx scripts/generate-openapi.ts && openapi-typescript packages/api-client/openapi.json -o packages/api-client/src/schema.d.ts && prettier packages/api-client/openapi.json packages/api-client/src/schema.d.ts --write
scripts.verify: pnpm api:check && pnpm format:check && pnpm lint && pnpm typecheck && pnpm test && pnpm test:privacy && pnpm build && pnpm exec openspec validate --all --strict && pnpm exec openspec validate --archived --strict
scripts.verify:release: pnpm verify && pnpm test:coverage && pnpm test:e2e && pnpm test:containers
